name: Michael
source:
If Gabriel is called the angel most cruel, Michael is called the angel most frightening.

This is because when Michael appears on site, he makes sinners and imposes summary justice regardless of angel or devil. This is mostly execution, and he beheads them as soon as he sentences them. Therefore, he is also called the Dust of Decapitation.
